title: Workspace-wide IntelliSense for every new script
changes: Autocomplete, type suggestions and hover now rebind when scripts are created, opened, renamed or imported
Workspace ModuleScript functions appear in completion lists after relative require calls
Support .lua and .luau files across nested scripts, modules and tests directories
Keep local functions private while suggesting only exported workspace module functions
Prevent stale completion and hover popups when switching files
Expand regression coverage without changing existing projects
